## Covariates

The six buoy-measured water/air conditions used by the forecast
models, all sourced from A01's own sensors (no external weather
forecast data is used):

| Covariate  | Description         | Sensor | Depth        | Units |
|------------|----------------------|--------|--------------|-------|
| temp_1m    | Water temperature    | sbe37  | 1m           | °C    |
| cond_1m    | Conductivity         | sbe37  | 1m           | mS/cm |
| temp_20m   | Water temperature    | sbe37  | 20m          | °C    |
| sal_20m    | Salinity             | sbe37  | 20m          | psu   |
| cond_20m   | Conductivity         | sbe37  | 20m          | mS/cm |
| air_temp   | Air temperature      | met    | -3m (above surface) | °C |

## Forecast pipeline

::: {style="max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto 3rem auto; overflow: hidden;"}
```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'flowchart': {'wrappingWidth': 400}}}%%
flowchart TD
    A["Today's chl-a observation + 6 covariates:<br/>&bull; Water temp (1m, 20m)<br/>&bull; Conductivity (1m, 20m)<br/>&bull; Salinity (20m)<br/>&bull; Air temperature"]
    A --> Q(("Is today's chlorophyll above 5 ug/L?"))

    Q -->|"Yes -- bloom in progress"| BM["4 Random Forests trained on past blooms:<br/>&bull; Days since bloom started<br/>&bull; Rise rate so far<br/>&bull; Day of year<br/>&bull; Recent forecast surprise<br/>&bull; Each covariate's own 7-day trend<br/>&bull; Within-day chl-a volatility"]
    BM --> BM1[Predict remaining peak magnitude]
    BM --> BM2[Predict remaining duration]
    BM --> BM4[Predict rise fraction]
    BM --> BM3[Predict decline rate]
    BM1 --> TRAJ["Build trajectory: rise to predicted peak<br/>at predicted rise rate, then decline at predicted fall rate"]
    BM2 --> TRAJ
    BM4 --> TRAJ
    BM3 --> TRAJ
    TRAJ --> OUT[7-day chlorophyll forecast]

    Q -->|"No -- calm"| CFC["6 Random Forests predict each covariate daily up to 7 days ahead"]
    CFC --> CM["Random Forest predicts tomorrow's chl-a<br/>from today's value + 6 forecasted covariates"]
    CM -->|"Repeat for each lead time (t) using<br/>forecasted chl-a for the previous day (t-1)"| CM
    CM --> OUT
```
:::

::: {style="max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 19px;"}
Each model is retrained from scratch each day on all historical data
up to that point. Which chlorophyll model runs depends on whether
today's real chlorophyll is currently above or below the bloom
threshold (5 ug/L):

- **Bloom day**: four Random Forests, trained on past bloom events,
  each predict one property of how the current bloom will play out:
  how high it will peak, how many more days it will last, what
  fraction of that remaining time will be spent still rising, and
  how fast it will decline once it peaks. These use today's buoy
  covariate readings and each covariate's own 7-day trend.
- **Calm day**: the 6 covariates are first forecast forward a day at
  a time (by their own Random Forests, using today's value + DOY to
  predict tomorrow's value). A Random Forest then recursively
  predicts each day's change in chlorophyll from the day before,
  using that day's forecasted covariates.

Coming soon: covariate details, data sources, and validation methodology.
:::
